document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Ch5-6 — Decision Rules

general_rules.condition: bar fits between two concrete faces, distance 0-1m
general_rules.action: deduct 10mm from nominal dimension for links and bent bars; 40mm for straight bars
provide transverse reinforcement: ΣAst >= As of one lapped bar

general_rules.condition: >50% bars lapped at one point AND adjacent lap spacing a <= 10ø
general_rules.action: transverse reinforcement must be links or U-bars anchored in body of section, positioned at outer sections of lap
provide additional confining links in anchorage zone: Ash = 0.25As×n1 parallel to tension face; Asv = 0.25As×n2 perpendicular; spacing ≤ 5×longitudinal bar dia
NOT permitted unless section minimum dimension >= 1m OR stress <= 80% design ultimate
Generally NOT permitted; exception for Class B/C ≤ 12mm with mandrel ≥ 4ø; larger only with proprietary CARES-approved system

slab_rules.condition: bottom reinforcement at end support, no fixity assumed
flat slab — negative moment in column strip
slab_rules.action: 2/3 of column strip negative moment in central half of column strip width
at least two bottom bars pass through each column
May be ignored structurally; show on drawing
Displace bars or cut/trim: compensating bars + trimmers extending min 45ø beyond hole
As SR-006 PLUS trim top and bottom; if slab depth > 250mm add diagonal reinforcement

slab_rules.condition: slab corner held down on both sides
slab_rules.action: Provide torsion reinforcement extending ≥ 1/5 shorter span; area each leg ≥ 3/4 max mid-span moment area
Place between column and 1.5d inside control perimeter; ≥2 perimeters; perimeter spacing ≤0.75d

slab_rules.condition: slab span and internal support, standard conditions
slab_rules.action: Bottom bars: length = 0.8×span + 0.5×tension_lap, alternately reversed. Top bars: extend 0.3×span each side; stagger alternately; outer limit 0.1×short_span or 600mm
Rib spacing ≤ 1.5m; rib depth (excl. topping) ≤ 4×top width; otherwise design as beams
Top bar min length = 2×cantilever over simple support; alternately staggered. Bottom area ≥ 0.5×top area

beam_rules.action: Provide 16mm side bars inside links at max 250mm pitch

beam_rules.condition: beam links, lateral spacing of legs
beam_rules.action: max lateral pitch = min(600mm, 0.75d); tension/compression bar must be within 150mm of vertical leg

beam_rules.condition: top bars at internal support, simplified rules
beam_rules.action: ≥60% of max support area extends 0.25L from support face; minimum any bar extends: max(0.15L, 45ø)

beam_rules.condition: bottom bars in span, continuous beam, simplified rules
beam_rules.action: ≥30% of max span area continues to 25mm from support; remainder within 0.15L of internal supports

beam_rules.condition: bottom bars at end support, no fixity
simple support assumed but monolithic construction
beam_rules.action: Design for bending moment ≥ 0.15 × max span moment

beam_rules.condition: bending top bars up into column

beam_rules.action: NOT recommended — makes it difficult to fix reinforcement
Only permitted where rib width >= 450mm; must add top locking link
Must be closed links with specified 135° hook shape (Figure 6.22)
Treat as deep beam; provide orthogonal mesh per face; min area max(0.001Ac, 150mm²/m); spacing ≤ min(2×width, 300mm)
Must not be detailed without specific design instructions — they can dramatically affect structural safety

column_rules.action: min(20×long_bar_dia, lesser_column_dim, 400mm); reduce to 0.6× within larger_dim of column from beam/slab
All compression bars must be within 150mm of a restrained bar; additional links required if not satisfied; not required for circular columns
Links for bursting: ΣAst >= As of one lapped bar; positioned at outer l0/3 sections of lap

column_rules.condition: moment connection, beam to edge column
column_rules.action: Prefer U-bars in beam depth; use L-bars only when distance A < anchorage length for that dia
Grade < 28/35 MPa not normally used; column grade must not exceed 1.4 × intersecting slab/beam grade
Provide surface reinforcement mesh: spacing ≤ 100mm, dia ≥ 4mm
